name: Prefrontal
description: Real-time agent topology tracking with force-directed graph visualization

enabled.description: Enable or disable the prefrontal plugin

staleThresholdMs.description: Time in ms before marking an agent as stale

guardianStaleThresholdMs.description: Time in ms before guardian triggers recovery

maxConcurrentWorkers.description: Maximum number of concurrent worker agents

effortRouting.description: Model lists for each effort tier

pollIntervalMs.description: Session store enrichment poll interval in milliseconds

stalenessThresholdMs.description: Time in ms before marking an agent as stuck

chatMinIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval for chat summary messages

chatMaxIntervalMs.description: Maximum interval for chat summary messages

persistPath.description: Path to persist topology state across restarts

hooks.description: HIGH AUTHORITY. Permission hooks execute operator-supplied scripts inside the gateway on every tool call, and their verdict can block the call. Disabled unless `enabled` is true.

enabled.description: Opt in to EXECUTING the scripts listed in before_tool. Defining a hook is not by itself consent to run it. Hooks fail CLOSED: a hook that is misconfigured, times out, crashes or emits invalid JSON denies the tool call.

allowedRoots.description: Directories a hook script must live under, symlinks resolved. Default: ~/.openclaw/hooks. Scripts outside these roots, and scripts that are group- or world-writable, are refused.

before_tool.description: Hooks consulted before each tool call.

tool.description: Tool name to gate, or "*" for every tool.

script.description: Absolute path to an EXECUTABLE FILE inside an allowed root. Not a shell command — it is run with execFile and no shell, so pipes, globs and interpolation are not available.

args.description: Arguments passed to the script verbatim. No shell expansion.

timeout.description: Milliseconds before the hook is killed and the call DENIED.

denialLimit.description: Consecutive denials of one tool before the agent is told to escalate to the user.

allowScripts.description: Enable the prefrontal.recipe.orchestrate gateway method, which evaluates a caller-supplied JavaScript function body inside the gateway process with the gateway's privileges and can spawn subagents.

allowPublish.description: Enable prefrontal.recipe.publish, which uploads a local recipe to JourneyKits using integrations.journey.apiKey.

allowRemoteInstall.description: Enable JourneyKits downloads in prefrontal.recipe.install (files are written under ~/.openclaw/workspace/kits). Converting a SKILL.md passed as skillMd stays available without this.
